title: The Falconer distance conjecture

result.label: The Falconer distance conjecture
result.statement: Resolves the Falconer distance conjecture in every dimension d ≥ 2: every compact set E R^d with Hausdorff dimension greater than d/2 determines a set of Euclidean distances of positive Lebesgue measure.
result.roleNote: The family's stated result in the release.
